title: Uniform bounded enlargement inside a weak presheaf monomorphism
statement:
Fix an input universe as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be a small ordinary category and $\mathcal P=\operatorname{Fun}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Set})$. Let $1$ be its terminal presheaf and $I$ a presheaf with maps $e_0,e_1:1\to I$ such that $\delta=(e_0,e_1):1\amalg1\to I$ is monic. For $i:U\to V$ and $j:K\to L$, put $i\square j:(V\times K)\amalg_{U\times K}(U\times L)\to V\times L$. Let $\mathrm{An}$ be the closure of a small set of monomorphisms under isomorphisms, pushouts, small transfinite compositions and arrow retracts. Assume $e_\varepsilon\square j\in\mathrm{An}$ for every monomorphism $j$ and $\varepsilon=0,1$, and $\delta\square i\in\mathrm{An}$ for every $i\in\mathrm{An}$. A map has the right lifting property against a class if every commutative square with left side in that class has a diagonal filler. Call a map naive fibrant if it has the right lifting property against $\mathrm{An}$, and an object $Z$ naive fibrant if $Z\to1$ is such a map. Write $[K,Z]_I$ for maps $K\to Z$ modulo the equivalence relation generated by the endpoint restrictions of maps $K\times I\to Z$. Let $W_I$ be the maps $u:K\to L$ for which $[L,Z]_I\to[K,Z]_I$ is bijective for every naive fibrant $Z$ in the input universe.

There is an infinite cardinal $\alpha$ in the input universe, greater than $|\operatorname{Mor}(A)|$, with the following uniform property. For every monomorphism $X\hookrightarrow Y$ in $W_I$ and every subpresheaf $U\subseteq Y$ of size less than $\alpha$, there is a subpresheaf $V\subseteq Y$ of size less than $\alpha$ containing $U$ such that $V\cap X\hookrightarrow V$ belongs to $W_I$. Here the size of a presheaf $F$ is the cardinality of $\coprod_{a\in\operatorname{Ob}(A)}F(a)$, intersections are computed objectwise, and the cardinal is independent of $X,Y,U$. No model structure is assumed.

source.place: Cisinski, Higher Categories and Homotopical Algebra, Lemma 2.4.38, with the cardinal chosen as in Lemma 2.4.37, printed pp. 65-66 (PDF pp. 80-81). Total-element size is equivalent to the category-of-elements size used there once the bound exceeds the size of A. Read online 2026-10-17; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this interval-homotopy lemma.
